# Extract survival relevant features

```{r}
## Read in data
general_dens_combined <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/general_densities_allpanels.csv")

general_dens_combined <- general_dens_combined %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad != "Unknown_Other")

general_dens_out <- general_dens_combined %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined_broad) %>% summarise(density = mean(density))

general_dens_wide <- general_dens_out %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = celltype_combined_broad, values_from = density) %>% ungroup() %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
```
```{r}
sce_Tcell <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas_full/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_T_07.rds")
```

# 1. Phenotypes

## Cox - Density 

### Mean 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- general_dens_wide

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce_Tcell$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce_Tcell$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce_Tcell$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce_Tcell$PID)]

#mean division 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% rownames
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_Tcell$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_Tcell$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_Tcell$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_Tcell$PID)]

identical(rownames(Cox_df), rownames(Cox_df_mean))

#run the model
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

multi_res$coefficients

#Plot hazard ratios
hr_dens_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_dens_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,-HR), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune tumor_metacluster_namess")+
ylab("HR for mean_density")+
theme_classic()+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.01,10))+
scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_dens_mean
```

```{r}
# Combined visualization in dot plot
cox_median <- plot_df_dens_median %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "median") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_median$group <- factor(cox_median$group, levels = cox_median$group)

cox_mean <- plot_df_dens_mean %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "mean") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_mean$group <- factor(cox_mean$group, levels = cox_mean$group)

plot_cox_combined <- rbind(cox_mean, cox_median)


library(ggnewscale)
ggplot(plot_cox_combined, aes(x=group, y = category,col = HR, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = plot_cox_combined,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_value), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")

plot_cox_combined$type <- "phenotypes"
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG")
both <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group,result) %>% count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group) %>% unfactor()
plot_cox_combined_fil$category <- ifelse(plot_cox_combined_fil$group %in% both, "both", plot_cox_combined_fil$category)
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(HR = mean(HR), p_value = mean(p_value), result = result, type = type) %>% unique()

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/GEN_cox_pheno_bubble.pdf", width = 3, height = 5)
ggplot(plot_cox_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,HR), y = type, shape = category, col = HR, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = plot_cox_combined_fil,aes(size = -log10(p_value), shape = category, col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
dev.off()

```



## Differential abundance testing 

Here as an approximation, we use the mean count of cell types across panels (rounded to an integer).

```{r}
general_count_out <- general_dens_combined %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined_broad) %>% summarise(Freq = round(mean(Freq), digits = 0))

general_count_wide <- general_count_out %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = celltype_combined_broad, values_from = Freq) %>% ungroup() %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% t()
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- general_count_wide

abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_Tcell)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_Tcell$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# Filter metaclusters that are differential abundant across at least 2 categories
MC_diff_abun <- DA_out %>% filter(sign == TRUE) %>% group_by(cluster, result) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n >= 2) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unique() %>% unfactor()
```

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score", "necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
#DA_out <- DA_out %>% filter(category %in% c("pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

DA_out_fil <- DA_out[DA_out$cluster %in% MC_diff_abun, ]

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/GEN_diffabun_pheno.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
ggplot(DA_out_fil, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out_fil,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Disease progression")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Filter metaclusters that are differential abundant across at least 2 categories
MC_diff_abun <- DA_out %>% filter(sign == TRUE) %>% group_by(cluster, result) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n >= 2) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unique() %>% unfactor()
```

## Extract survival relevant and all features

```{r}
MC_surv_relevant <- c(str_remove(plot_df_dens_median %>% filter(p_value < 0.05) %>% pull(group), "B"), str_remove(plot_df_dens_mean %>% filter(p_value < 0.05) %>% pull(group), "B"), MC_diff_abun) %>% unique()
MC_surv_relevant[1] <- "B_cell" 


MC_surv_relevant_df <- general_dens_out %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad %in% MC_surv_relevant) %>% select(PID, celltype_combined_broad, density) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = celltype_combined_broad, values_from = density) %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(complete.cases(.))

colnames(MC_surv_relevant_df) <- paste0("MC_",colnames(MC_surv_relevant_df))
colnames(MC_surv_relevant_df)[1] <- "PID"

# Add survival and status OS
MC_surv_relevant_df$status_OS <- sce_Tcell$status_OS[match(MC_surv_relevant_df$PID, sce_Tcell$PID)]
MC_surv_relevant_df$OS_months <- sce_Tcell$OS_months[match(MC_surv_relevant_df$PID, sce_Tcell$PID)]

MC_surv_relevant_df <- MC_surv_relevant_df %>% select(PID, status_OS, OS_months, everything())
```


```{r}
# Save
write_csv(MC_surv_relevant_df, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/general_key_features.csv")
```
